g.text: Sequence Diagram - BCK10 Consult a Predefined Pizza
[Product does not exist or has no default composition]
[Product is a configured component-based Sellable Product]
The URL parameter is the ProductId shared with BCK05. Consultation returns
the maintained default composition. Authentication, authorization,
validation and asynchronous route errors are mapped by the global error
handler. BCK11 calculates catalogue price and availability separately.
